problem.name: Multicollisions in a random function
problem.statement_latex: Given a random function $f:[D]\to[N]$ with sufficiently large domain and fixed $\ell\ge2$, find distinct $x_1,\ldots,x_\ell$ satisfying $f(x_1)=\cdots=f(x_\ell)$. Complexity counts random-oracle queries.
